threats.description: Hostile directives or leaked credentials embedded in NotebookLM research_briefing.md attempting to escalate privileges during IntentContract synthesis.
threats.mitigation: Mandatory UntrustedContentEnvelope wrapping (envelope.wrap_untrusted_content) with regex injection stripping, secret redaction, and NONE_DATA_ONLY authority enforcement.

threats.description: Sandbox test execution mutating live repository state or touching immutable Layer A files.
threats.mitigation: Isolated ephemeral git worktree under /tmp with automatic git worktree remove --force cleanup and Layer A path guard.

threats.description: Syntax errors, broken imports, or non-deterministic test failures masquerading as a valid TESTS_ARMED_RED state (V12-05).
threats.mitigation: Triple RED Oracle requires py_compile CompilationSuccess==True, RuntimeExecution=='EXECUTED', zero build/collection/infra errors, explicit oracle_id binding, and identical failure sets across two seeded runs.

threats.description: Secret tokens leaking into generated Obsidian Markdown dashboards or ProofReceipt artifacts.
threats.mitigation: Pre-write envelope.redact_text and secrets.assert_clean gate on all generated Markdown and JSON projections.

threats.description: Unsigned or tampered ProofReceipt packages claiming verification completion.
threats.mitigation: Ed25519 signature via ssh-keygen -Y sign under kernel:authority (metaos.receipt / metaos.kernel) verified against .antigravity/keys/allowed_signers.
